paired.method: Fresh embedded processes; same release flags/compiler/allocator; reversed order confirmation; five warmups excluded from latency but included in exact response checks; hashing outside latency. No tests/builds overlapped cohorts; shared host noise remains.

limitations: Sidebar mean essentially unchanged; reverse cohort slightly slower, first cohort P99 worse. No universal tail dominance.
Bulk candidate latency is bimodal across legs; retain every leg instead of selecting the best.
RSS and apparent authority bytes show no memory/space win. Not native heap or allocated disk measurements.
Raw SQLite is a semantic floor rather than the complete application authority. Candidate still slower in these reads.
1000-active-attempt capacity, FUSE durability/performance, long soak, browser delivery, and all-scene leadership are not certified. Running application not restarted.

diagnostic.scope: Unoptimized debug build; profiling enabled; diagnostic counts establish path use, not production latency or performance ratios. No compilation overlapped these request samples.
diagnostic.conclusion: Archive served 4425 accesses across these query samples; no basis for an archive invisibility workaround. Archive load fell back 575 times. Served calls and fallback calls are not per-conversation coverage certificates.
